| \(p \ge 0.95\) | 95% | Two-sided 95% Clopper–Pearson | **72** | Equal tails use \(\alpha/2=0.025\): \(n=\left\lceil\ln(0.025)/\ln(0.95)\right\rceil=\lceil71.92\rceil=72\) (pqac-00000050, pqac-00000053) |
